ImageDescription.value: TOWN THAT WAS A STRATEGIC SITE IN THE BATTLE OF THE YSER RIVER IN OCTOBER 1914; THE TOWN WAS TOTALLY DESTROYED.  THE "TRENCH OF DEATH" (DODENGANG) LIES ALONG THE RIVER JUST NORTHWEST OF THE 	TOWN. HERE BELGIAN AND GERMAN CONFRONTED EACH OTHER FOR 4 YEARS. TRENCHES ARE ORIGINAL BUT 	THE SAND BAGS HAVE BEEN REPLACED WITH CEMENT MADE TO LOOK LIKE SAND BAGS
